items.name: Starter Website
items.description: The foundation for most local service businesses: Home, About, Services, a proof page (Projects/Reviews) and Contact.

items.name: Lead-Gen Business Website
items.description: For businesses with several distinct services or service areas that each deserve a ranking page.

items.name: E-commerce Starter
items.description: Adds a product catalog, cart and checkout (up to 50 products loaded).

items.name: Standard Page
items.description: An informational page such as About, Team, FAQ, Careers or Financing.

items.name: Service Page
items.description: A dedicated page for one service: what it is, signs you need it, process, proof, FAQs and a service-specific CTA. Ranks for that service's searches.

items.name: Location / Service-Area Page
items.description: A page for one city or service area with genuinely local content (projects, reviews, regulations). Only recommended when the business really serves that area.

items.name: Advanced Page
items.description: A page with custom functionality: cost calculator, filterable project gallery, interactive menu, comparison tool or client portal entry.

items.name: Legal Page
items.description: Privacy policy, terms or accessibility statement based on the client's provided policy text.

items.name: Blog / Resource Article
items.description: One researched article (1,200 to 1,800 words) targeting a real customer question, linked into the related service page.

items.name: Resource Hub Setup
items.description: Blog/resources index with categories, internal linking and article templates. Required once before articles are published.

items.name: Managed Forms
items.description: Form configuration, lead routing with fallback, spam protection and delivery monitoring with alerts.

items.name: AI Customer Service Chat
items.description: Answers approved customer questions 24/7, routes visitors to the right service and captures leads after hours.

items.name: Live Chat
items.description: Lets visitors talk to staff in real time during business hours.

items.name: AI Lead Qualification
items.description: Collects and qualifies prospects conversationally before they reach the sales team.

items.name: Appointment Booking
items.description: Visitors schedule appointments or site visits directly, synced to the business calendar.

items.name: Estimate / Quote System
items.description: Multi-step quote request that gathers the details needed for an accurate estimate.

items.name: File / Photo Uploads
items.description: Customers attach project photos, plans or documents to their request.

items.name: CRM Integration
items.description: Sends leads into the client's existing CRM or workflow tool.

items.name: Review Integration
items.description: Displays verified customer reviews and ratings from Google or other platforms.

items.name: Email / SMS Notifications
items.description: Instant alerts to staff when a customer submits a form, books or pays.

items.name: Payment Integration
items.description: Accept online deposits or full payments.

items.name: Newsletter Signup
items.description: Captures email subscribers for ongoing nurturing.
